overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured conventional MRI metadata without diffusion, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histomolecular testing. The strongest imaging signal is an aggressive, large, markedly enhancing, edematous, invasive solitary mass in an older adult. Molecular confirmation remains required, especially because conventional MRI cannot directly determine IDH or 1p/19q status.
